column1: # Cape Town: three tables and no majority (research Cape Town section), each printed for Cape Town
# (rulings R30, R44).
# - za.mjc: the Muslim Judicial Council's website times, September 2026 (one month: fit, nothing held out).
# - za.voc: the community calendar (VOC, the Wembley calendar and masjids.co.za carry the same numbers),
#   Wembley's Shafi'i and Hanafi tables split by year in the local archive (africaoceania/split-7g/): the
#   2026 rows (21 June to December) fit, the 2027 rows (January to 5 June) held out, with masjids.co.za's
#   June-December 2026 relay and Wembley's own 17 September-1 October page (the same calendar) also held out.
# - za.cape (cautious): September 2026, the month all three tables are held at the Cape Town point
#   (slices in split-7g): the MJC's, the community calendar's (masjids.co.za's relay) and Jamiat's Cape Town table with
#   its Shafi'i Isha (the member za.jamiat.shafii), each start against the latest of those held that day,
#   Maghrib too (ruling R155; until then against the MJC's where the members spread beyond 2 min, the 26 Sep cap).
# - October 2026: the MJC's month as the weekly monitor captured it on 1 Oct 2026 (archive/tables/monitor/za-mjc/,
#   one file a month, kept), held out, as za.mjc's own row and as za.cape's member; and at the Cape Town point the
#   community calendar's October twice, masjids.co.za's relay (all 31 days, no sunrise, as in September) and the
#   Wembley calendar's own rows (the 20 days it prints; a member printing a date twice keeps its stricter line), and
#   Jamiat's Cape Town October with its Shafi'i Isha (slices in split-7g, as September's).
# End of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026, before Ramadan 1448): the MJC's Fajr is also the end of sehri (Radio 786), and the
# community calendar prints no sehri column: both members' Fajr columns are now also checked as the end
# of eating (F+E), as Jamiat's printed sehri column (E) was. An end never after any Cape Town table's.
